verdict.rationale: Twenty documents the core pieces as its own features. It has REST/GraphQL APIs that support batch record updates, and an MCP server listed on every plan. Connected Google or Microsoft email and calendar events link automatically to CRM records. Native AI agents can run multi-step tasks, can be scoped by role, and can score opportunities on engagement patterns. However, no documented flow has an agent read email or meeting signals and update deal stage or next-step fields, and the MCP server's tool surface is undocumented beyond a pricing line. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools for reading emails or meetings and updating opportunities, an explicit stage or next-step update use case from activity signals, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
